title: navigation
description: Client -> robot. Correlated named-waypoint navigation operations. Every request_id is idempotent for the lifetime of the robot session: retrying the same request_id must return the same result and must never start a second physical goal. A start request is explicit authorization to move; conversational or UI confirmation belongs in the client. The robot remains responsible for session authorization, localization, active-map matching, Nav2 readiness and E-stop enforcement.

name.description: Named waypoint on the robot's active saved map. Required by remember_waypoint, delete_waypoint and start.

goal_id.description: Client-generated goal identity. Required by start; optional on cancel/status to address one goal explicitly.
